Amendment 2 is being issued to provide a revised Attachment 1, Statement of Work. The revised Statement of Work supersedes and replaces the version previously issued with the solicitation. Changes to the Statement of Work are identified in red font for ease of reference.

*****************************************

Amendment 1 is being issued to provide additional guidance and instructions for registering for Fermilab site access to attend the Site Visit.

*****************************************

Fermi Forward Discovery Group, LLC (FFDG), operator of Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory (Fermilab), is soliciting proposals for housekeeping services for residential facilities located at Fermilab in Batavia, Illinois. Services include housekeeping of dormitory rooms, common areas, houses, apartments, and associated facilities. See the attached RFP and Statement of Work for complete requirements.
